newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney wheat futures up on spread trading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney wheat futures up on spread trading.

text.p: Nearby January wheat edged higher at the Sydney Futures Exchange on Thursday.
Trading a A$2.00 a tonne spread between January and May wheat was the the main note in an otherwise featuerless day of trading, grains traders said.
At least two trade houses were selling the spread with local investors taking the opposite side, they said.
"With a spread of A$2.00, there's a bit of move to out on way or the other," one said.
Investors recently have been content to buy January wheat at A$2.00 a tonne under the March contract, with the expection that the spread will widen, the trader said.
"Factoring in the cost of carry, you would expect at some stage it will," the trader said.
However, others think the spread could narrow.
"You could take the attitude that if we have an abundance of wheat, then the price in March may be lower than the price in January," another trader said.
